summary: The fixed rules shared by the recall eval, kept byte-identical to the coldstart v2 eval so other repos' results are comparable: WORK dir (env WORK overrides eval/recall/work/), rightNotes (needed ∪ useful ∪ same-session notes ONLY if a compaction happened since — a note the agent still holds is not 'right'), loadNotes from work/notes/*.md frontmatter ids, cleanBody (drops '## Part of' links, wikilinks, backticked paths), historyText (the labeller's exact dialogue clipping: dev 200+80, agent 80+170, prompt 600+200), the code-work-vs-chat CRITERIA strings, and a BM25 with the shipped k1 1.2 / b .75 over title+body whose df/avgdl are computed only over notes that existed at the prompt. Do not tune these on the set being scored.
